qa_pairs.question: What components are located on the left side of the trunk according to Figure 1?
qa_pairs.answer: According to Figure 1, the left side of the trunk contains the rear lights check relay and the amplifier.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the battery located in the BMW E30 M3?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery is located on the right side of the trunk, as shown in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: What is the gas filler lock motor's location in the vehicle?
qa_pairs.answer: The gas filler lock motor is located on the right side of the trunk, as indicated in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: Which figure shows the trunk lid lock motor?
qa_pairs.answer: Figure 2 shows the trunk lid lock motor, which is located at the center rear of the trunk.

qa_pairs.question: What component is labeled G100 in the trunk area?
qa_pairs.answer: G100 appears to be a component or connector located near the battery and gas filler lock motor area on the right side of the trunk.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the trunk light switch located?
qa_pairs.answer: The trunk light switch is located at the center rear of the trunk lid, as shown in Figure 4.

qa_pairs.question: How many figures are shown on this component location views page?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 4 figures shown on this page: Figure 1 (LH Side of Trunk), Figure 2 (Center Rear of Trunk), Figure 3 (RH Side of Trunk), and Figure 4 (Center Rear of Trunk Lid).

qa_pairs.question: What is the page number and section title for this documentation?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 7000-12 from the Component Location Views section.
